about: Each row is one HoloCure stage, played as a Minecraft night. Night 1 is Stage 1; clearing a stage's boss marks it cleared for the world and the next night plays the next stage (only Stage 1 in v0.1, replayed harder each night). Generates StageDef.

columns.music: holocure sound; plays during the night
columns.night_scaling: float; HP multiplier added per stage already cleared in this world
columns.room: holocure room; the stage map whose ground and placements are copied
columns.ground_sprite: holocure sprite; the tiled floor texture
columns.ground_cells: int; the floor texture is cut into ground_cells x ground_cells blocks (<= 40)
columns.map_px_per_block: int; HoloCure map pixels per Minecraft block (placements and floor)
columns.surface_y: int; Minecraft y of the stage floor
columns.world_type: string; the name shown in Create World > World Type
